name: mouseline
title: MouseLine
description: Control MouseLine, the mouse gesture app for macOS: turn gestures on or off, pause them in the current app, open settings or calibrate.
author: opendino

commands.name: toggle-gestures
commands.title: Toggle Gestures
commands.subtitle: MouseLine
commands.description: Turn MouseLine's mouse gestures on or off.

commands.name: toggle-frontmost-app
commands.title: Toggle Gestures in Current App
commands.subtitle: MouseLine
commands.description: Turn gestures off (or back on) in the app you are using, e.g. a game or a 3D tool.

commands.name: calibrate
commands.title: Calibrate Gestures
commands.subtitle: MouseLine
commands.description: Open MouseLine's calibration, which fits recognition to how you draw.
